decisions.DEC-CLOCK: C1: T5 subset rule on the observed interval; contained = in window, disjoint = late, overlap = INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.DEC-EQUIV: E3: boundary / short-window LATE vs ABSENT stays UNRESOLVED and is excluded pre-run; under the default window LATE and ABSENT remain two faults
decisions.DEC-SAMPLE: S1: full grid, N = 1 per unit (base scene x fault x parameter vector); S2 hard subset is the declared resource fallback
decisions.DEC-RESOURCE: R1: ROUNDS, remaining = 8 per cell, identical across arms
decisions.DEC-TRUTH: T3: presence/order faults use the confirmation token; endpoint and equivalence cases stay unresolved
decisions.LUR-ACK: no deadline invented; AX-LUR-ACK-TICK points are H-NORMAL timing perturbations
decisions.R1-rule: mixed VALID set containing h_normal without T5 resolution is INCONCLUSIVE

contrasts.test: exact two-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs)
exact two-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs)

decisionRules: A contrast is supported only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and the discordant-pair direction favours CL-LOOP.
If there are zero discordant pairs, report p = 1 and 'no difference observable at this grid'; do not reinterpret it as equivalence.
Non-significant and adverse results are reported unchanged.
Report counts of discordant pairs (b, c) and the paired difference in proportions with an exact 95% confidence interval for each contrast.
stoppingRules: Run all 312 cells exactly once; no interim looks; no early stopping.

A cell that fails for an infrastructure reason (exception, not a verdict) is re-run once at the same commit and recorded as such; if it fails again it is reported as MISSING and excluded from both arms of that pair.
No cell, unit, metric or contrast may be added, removed or redefined after freeze except through a new CR that labels any later analysis exploratory.
dataRules: Pilot artefacts under artifacts/pilot/ are never reused.
Confirmatory output goes to artifacts/confirmatory/ with the commit SHA and these config hashes recorded in every row.
knownRisk: The pilot showed a ceiling effect. If arms agree on nearly every unit, discordant pairs will be few and H1/H2 may be non-significant; this is reported as is.
